answer: The test is Registered weft winder bobbin file with weft winders endorsement. Passing it takes 3-year training, 170 supervised windings, husbandry exam, annual re-assessment, and the test is given separately to every key. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 579 fakes need 579, at 104 POA each, totalling 60216 POA. The quill is the evidence, the canyon is the expense, and the delta is the expiry that forces the farm to pay again. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
